messages:
maya (partnerships): Heads up — Zetta has offered prototype boards for a joint perf/W + kernel-tuning sweep. Want to run a reproducible benchmark next week and publish a co-auth blog + perf appendix. Need a runbook, telemetry schema, and owner list.
leo (perf): +1. Which metrics are we standardizing on? throughput (tokens/s), p95 latency, power (W), and efficiency (tokens/J)?
sasha (eng-runtime): yes to all of the above. Also record resident memory, KV-cache hit rate, and quantization config. We should capture sequence length distribution.
maya (partnerships): agreed. Propose minimal metric set: total_tokens/s, p50/p95/p99 latency, avg_power_W (IPMI), tokens_per_joule. Extra: kernel-params, batch-size, seq-len.
leo (perf): toolchain: use our perf harness (bench-v2). For power we can use IPMI on the PDUs + Zetta's on-board sensors as fallback. Need sync on sampling rate (1s).
sasha (eng-runtime): draft config for bench-v2:
```
model: redwood-3b
quant: int8
batch_sizes: [1,4,8,16]
seq_lengths: [32,128,512]
sampling: deterministic
slo_targets: { p95_ms: 120 }
power_poll_interval_s: 1
```
sasha (eng-runtime): also add kernel toggles we want to sweep:
- qat=on/off
- use_optimized_attention=on/off
- prefetch_threads=1/2/4

tom@zetta: tom@zetta here — we can ship 4 boards next Monday. We'll provide driver build + kernel patches. For power: we expose IPMI and a telemetry REST API (1s granularity). Which do you prefer?
leo (perf): prefer IPMI as canonical; include REST as secondary. Need mapping of sensor IDs.
rahul (devex): I can add a telemetry exporter that normalizes IPMI + REST into our bench output (JSON lines). Need a sample payload from Zetta.
ingrid (ops): scheduling note — racks where boards will live are on shared PDUs. Peak draw per rack ~3.6kW. We'll need a reservation window and a jump box for remote access. Also need power-cycling permission for partner engineers.
maya (partnerships): ingestion schema proposal (minimal):
- run_id
- timestamp
- board_id
- model
- batch_size
- seq_len
- tokens_generated
- elapsed_s
- power_W_avg
- cpu_temp_C
- kernel_flags
- notes

rahul (devex): cool — I'll publish a sample JSON schema in the repo by EOD and wire up bench-v2 to emit it.
bench-bot: Job queued: runbook-checklist-generation (id: rb-20260321-01). Estimated ETA: 2h.
leo (perf): acceptance gates for public table: tokens_per_joule >= baseline * 1.05 OR no >5% regression in p95 vs baseline. If regressions exist, we require root-cause (kernel param diff / quant diff) documented.
sasha (eng-runtime): owners (tentative):
- runbook writeup: maya
- harness + telemetry exporter: rahul
- kernel tuning tests + patches: tom@zetta + sasha
- infra & scheduling: ingrid
- perf analysis and plots: leo

tom@zetta: pushed driver patch diff to https://git.zt/patches/zetta-kern-023 — will follow up with sensor ID map.
maya (partnerships): thanks. Let's do a dry-run Tuesday 10am PT to validate telemetry and canary configs. If dry-run OK, full sweep starts Wed.
leo (perf): allocating a short-lived canary: one board, batch sizes [1,8], seq [128], 2x replicate. I'll monitor.
rahul (devex): I'll add a CI job that validates schema + a lint step on bench results.
ingrid (ops): reserving rack Tues-Wed window and adding partner ssh keys. Please DM me with the user list.
maya (partnerships): perfect. I'll send a calendar invite and a short public blurb draft for legal/partner review.
sasha (eng-runtime): updated perf flags checklist: `export PERF_NOTIFY=1; ./bench-v2 --emit-jsonl` — keep logs in /var/log/bench/zetta.
maya (partnerships): any blockers? otherwise closing this thread and tracking in doc.
leo (perf): none from perf side. :thumbsup:
tom@zetta: no blockers. will post sensor map by EOD.
bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run meeting in 48h (link: https://meet.redwood/zetta-dryrun).
maya (partnerships): thanks all — moving to doc now.
